P6.label: head of government
P6.description: head of the executive power of this town, city, municipality, state, country, or other governmental body

P17.label: country
P17.description: sovereign state that this subject item is in (not to be used for human beings)

P19.label: place of birth
P19.description: most specific known birth location of a person, animal or fictional character

P20.label: place of death
P20.description: most specific known (e.g. city instead of country, or hospital instead of city) death location of a person, animal or fictional character

P21.label: sex or gender
P21.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

P22.label: father
P22.description: male parent of the subject. For stepfather, use "stepparent" (P3448)

P25.label: mother
P25.description: female parent of the subject. For stepmother, use "stepparent" (P3448)

P26.label: spouse
P26.description: the subject has the object as their spouse (husband, wife, partner, etc.). Use "unmarried partner" (P451) for non-married companions

P27.label: country of citizenship
P27.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

P30.label: continent
P30.description: continent of which the subject is a part

P31.label: instance of
P31.description: type to which this subject corresponds/belongs. Different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain

P35.label: head of state
P35.description: official with the highest formal authority in a country/state

P36.label: capital
P36.description: seat of government of a country, province, state or other type of administrative territorial entity

P37.label: official language
P37.description: language designated as official by this item

P39.label: position held
P39.description: subject currently or formerly holds the object position or public office

P40.label: child
P40.description: subject has object as child. Do not use for stepchildren—use "relative" (P1038), qualified with "kinship to subject" (P1039)

P50.label: author
P50.description: main creator(s) of a written work (use on works, not humans); use P2093 (author name string) when Wikidata item is unknown or does not exist

P54.label: member of sports team
P54.description: sports teams or clubs that the subject represents or represented

P57.label: director
P57.description: director(s) of film, TV-series, stageplay, video game or similar

P58.label: screenwriter
P58.description: person(s) who wrote the script for subject item

P61.label: discoverer or inventor
P61.description: subject who discovered, first described, invented, or developed this discovery or invention or scientific hypothesis or theory

P84.label: architect
P84.description: person or architectural firm responsible for designing this building

P86.label: composer
P86.description: person(s) who wrote the music [for lyricist, use "lyrics by" (P676)]

P101.label: field of work
P101.description: specialization of a person or organization; see P106 for the occupation/ P452 for industry

P102.label: member of political party
P102.description: the political party of which a person is or has been a member or otherwise affiliated

P106.label: occupation
P106.description: occupation of a person. See also "field of work" (Property:P101), "position held" (Property:P39). Not for groups of people. There, use "field of work" (Property:P101), "industry" (Property:P452), "members have occupation" (Property:P3989).

P108.label: employer
P108.description: person or organization for which the subject works or worked

P110.label: illustrator
P110.description: person drawing the pictures or taking the photographs in a book or similar work

P112.label: founder
P112.description: founder or co-founder of this organization, religion, place or entity

P115.label: home venue
P115.description: home stadium or venue of a sports team or performing arts organization

P118.label: league or competition
P118.description: league or competition in which team or player has played, or in which an event occurs

P123.label: publisher
P123.description: organization or person responsible for publishing a work, such as a book, periodical, printed music, podcast, game or software

P131.label: located in the administrative territorial entity
aliases: is in the Indian reservation of
is in the Indian reserve of
is in the administrative region of
is in the local government area of
is in the rural city of
is in the principal area of
P131.description: the item is located on the territory of the following administrative entity. Use P276 for specifying locations that are non-administrative places and for items about events. Use P1382 if the item falls only partially into the administrative entity

P136.label: genre
P136.description: creative work's genre or an artist's field of work (P101). Use main subject (P921) to relate creative works to their topic

P138.label: named after
P138.description: entity or event that inspired the subject's name, or namesake (in at least one language). Qualifier "applies to name" (P5168) can be used to indicate which one

P140.label: religion or worldview
P140.description: religion of a person, organization or religious building, or associated with this subject

P144.label: based on
P144.description: the work(s) or inputs used as the basis for subject item; for fictional analog use P1074

P155.label: follows
P155.description: immediately prior item in a series of which the subject is a part, preferably use as qualifier of P179 [if the subject has replaced the preceding item, e.g. political offices, use "replaces" (P1365)]

P156.label: followed by
P156.description: immediately following item in a series of which the subject is a part, preferably use as qualifier of P179 [if the subject has been replaced, e.g. political offices, use "replaced by" (P1366)]

P159.label: headquarters location
P159.description: city or town where an organization's headquarters is or has been situated. Use P276 qualifier for specific building

P161.label: cast member
P161.description: actor in the subject production [use "character role" (P453) and/or "name of the character role" (P4633) as qualifiers] [use "voice actor" (P725) for voice-only role] - [use "recorded participant" (P11108) for non-fiction productions]

P162.label: producer
P162.description: person(s) who produced the film, musical work, theatrical production, etc. (for film, this does not include executive producers, associate producers, etc.) [for production company, use P272, video games - use P178]

P166.label: award received
P166.description: award or recognition received by a person, organization or creative work

P169.label: chief executive officer
P169.description: highest-ranking corporate officer appointed as the CEO within an organization

P170.label: creator
P170.description: maker of this creative work or other object (where no more specific property exists)

P171.label: parent taxon
P171.description: closest parent taxon of the taxon in question

P175.label: performer
P175.description: actor, musician, band or other performer associated with this role or musical work

P176.label: manufacturer
P176.description: (main or final) manufacturer or producer of this product

P178.label: developer
P178.description: organization or person that developed the item

P183.label: endemic to
P183.description: sole location or habitat type where the taxon lives

P186.label: made from material
P186.description: material the subject or the object is made of or derived from (do not confuse with P10672 which is used for processes)

P206.label: located in or next to body of water
aliases: located next to body of water
P206.description: body of water on or next to which a place is located

P264.label: record label
P264.description: brand and trademark associated with the marketing of subject music recordings and music videos

P272.label: production company
P272.description: company that produced this film, audio or performing arts work

P274.label: chemical formula
P274.description: description of chemical compound giving element symbols and counts

P276.label: location
P276.description: location of the object, structure or event; use P131 to indicate the containing administrative entity, P8138 for statistical entities, or P706 for geographic entities; use P7153 for locations associated with the object

P279.label: subclass of
aliases: all members of this class also belong to
whose instances are a subset of those of
P279.description: this item is a subclass (subset) of that item; ALL instances of this item are instances of that item; different from P31 (instance of), e.g.: volcano is a subclass of mountain; Everest is an instance of mountain

P286.label: head coach
P286.description: on-field manager or head coach of a sports club (not to be confused with a general manager P505, which is not a coaching position) or person

P361.label: part of
P361.description: object of which the subject is a part (if this subject is already part of object A which is a part of object B, then please only make the subject part of object A), inverse property of "has part" (P527, see also "has parts of the class" (P2670))

P364.label: original language of film or TV show
P364.description: language in which a film or a performance work was originally created. Deprecated for written works and songs; use P407 ("language of work or name") instead.

P366.label: has use
P366.description: main use of the subject (includes current and former usage)

P397.label: parent astronomical body
P397.description: major astronomical body the item belongs to

P403.label: mouth of the watercourse
P403.description: the body of water to which the watercourse drains

P407.label: language of work or name
P407.description: language associated with this creative work (such as books, shows, songs, broadcasts or websites) or a name (for persons use "native language" (P103) and "languages spoken, written or signed" (P1412))

P413.label: position played on team / speciality
P413.description: position or specialism of a player on a team

P425.label: field of this occupation
P425.description: field corresponding to this occupation or profession (use only for occupations/professions - for people use Property:P101, for companies use P452)

P449.label: original broadcaster
P449.description: network(s) or service(s) that originally broadcast a radio or television program

P451.label: unmarried partner
P451.description: someone with whom the person is in a relationship without being married. Use "spouse" (P26) for married couples

P452.label: industry
P452.description: specific industry of company or organization

P453.label: character role
P453.description: specific role played or filled by subject -- use only as qualifier of "cast member" (P161), "voice actor" (P725)

P460.label: said to be the same as
aliases: is said to be the same as
considered to be the same as
P460.description: this item is said to be the same as that item, though this may be uncertain or disputed

P461.label: opposite of
P461.description: item that is in some way the opposite of this item

P463.label: member of
P463.description: organization, club or musical group to which the subject belongs. Do not use for membership in ethnic or social groups, nor for holding a political position, such as a member of parliament (use P39 for that)

P488.label: chairperson
P488.description: presiding member of an organization, group or body

P495.label: country of origin
P495.description: country of origin of this item (creative work, food, phrase, product, etc.)

P509.label: cause of death
P509.description: underlying or immediate cause of death. Underlying cause (e.g. car accident, stomach cancer) preferred. Use 'manner of death' (P1196) for broadest category, e.g. natural causes, accident, homicide, suicide

P516.label: powered by
P516.description: equipment used by the subject to convert a source into mechanical or electrical energy

P518.label: applies to part
P518.description: part, aspect, or form of the item to which the claim applies

P527.label: has part(s)
P527.description: part of this subject; inverse property of "part of" (P361). See also "has parts of the class" (P2670).

P569.label: date of birth
P569.description: date on which the subject was born

P570.label: date of death
P570.description: date on which the subject died

P571.label: inception
P571.description: time when an entity begins to exist; for date of official opening use P1619

P575.label: time of discovery or invention
P575.description: date or point in time when the item was discovered or invented

P576.label: dissolved, abolished or demolished
P576.description: point in time at which the subject (organisation, building) ceased to exist; see "date of official closure" (P3999) for closing a facility, "service retirement" (P730) for retiring equipment, "discontinued date" (P2669) for stopping a product

P577.label: publication date
P577.description: date or point in time when a work or product was first published or released

P580.label: start time
P580.description: time an entity begins to exist or a statement starts being valid

P582.label: end time
P582.description: moment when an entity ceases to exist and a statement stops being entirely valid or no longer be true

P585.label: point in time
P585.description: date something took place, existed or a statement was true; for providing time use the "refine date" property (P4241)

P610.label: highest point
P610.description: point with highest elevation in a region or path

P619.label: UTC date of spacecraft launch
P619.description: date of spacecraft launch in UTC

P620.label: UTC date of spacecraft landing
P620.description: date of spacecraft landing in UTC

P641.label: sport
P641.description: sport that the subject participates or participated in or is associated with

P664.label: organizer
P664.description: person or institution organizing an event

P674.label: characters
P674.description: characters which appear in this item (like plays, operas, operettas, books, comics, films, TV series, video games)

P703.label: found in taxon
P703.description: the taxon in which the item can be found

P710.label: participant
P710.description: person, group of people or organization (object) that actively takes/took part in an event or process (subject). Preferably qualify with "object has role" (P3831). Use P1923 for participants that are teams.

P725.label: voice actor
P725.description: performer of a spoken role in a creative work such as animation, video game, radio drama, or dubbing over [use "character role" (P453) as qualifier] [use "cast member" (P161) for live acting]

P729.label: service entry
P729.description: date or point in time on which a piece or class of equipment entered operational service

P730.label: service retirement
P730.description: date or point in time on which a piece or class of equipment was retired from operational service ; use P2669 for end of a public service

P737.label: influenced by
P737.description: the subject (person, idea, etc.) was influenced or inspired by this object entity, e.g. "Heidegger was influenced by Aristotle"

P740.label: location of formation
P740.description: location where a group or organization was formed

P742.label: pseudonym
P742.description: alias used by someone (for nickname use P1449)

P749.label: parent organization or unit
P749.description: parent organization or unit of an organization or unit, opposite of child organization or unit (P355); use instance of (P31) to distinguish organization (Q43229) and organization unit (Q10387680)

P750.label: distributed by
P750.description: distributor of a creative work; distributor for a record label; news agency; film distributor

P780.label: symptoms and signs
P780.description: possible symptoms or signs of a medical condition

P800.label: notable work
P800.description: notable scientific, artistic or literary work, or other work of significance among subject's works

P805.label: statement is subject of
P805.description: (qualifying) item that describes the relation identified in this statement

P828.label: has cause
P828.description: underlying cause, entity that ultimately resulted in this effect

P840.label: narrative location
P840.description: the narrative of the work is set in this location

P885.label: origin of the watercourse
aliases: origin of the body of water
P885.description: main source of a river, stream or lake

P915.label: filming location
P915.description: actual place where this scene/film was shot. For the setting, use "narrative location" (P840)

P921.label: main subject
P921.description: primary topic of a work or act of communication

P941.label: inspired by
P941.description: work, human, place or event which inspired this creative work or fictional entity

P991.label: successful candidate
P991.description: person(s) or political organization(s) elected after the election

P1034.label: main food source
P1034.description: species, genus or family that an organism depends on for nutrition

P1037.label: director / manager
P1037.description: person who manages any kind of group or organisation

P1056.label: product or material produced
aliases: product, material, or service produced or provided
P1056.description: material or product, including services, produced or provided by an organization, industry, facility, or process

P1060.label: disease transmission process
P1060.description: process by which a pathogen is transmitted, equivalent to "transmitted by" in the relation ontology http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/RO_0002451

P1080.label: from narrative universe
aliases: fictional universe where entity is from
P1080.description: subject's fictional entity is in the object narrative. See also P1441 (present in work) and P1445 (fictional universe described in)

P1082.label: population
P1082.description: number of people inhabiting the place; number of people of subject

P1086.label: atomic number
P1086.description: number of protons found in the nucleus of the atom

P1113.label: number of episodes
P1113.description: number of episodes in a film/TV/radio series

P1120.label: number of deaths
P1120.description: total (cumulative) number of people/animals who died since start as a direct result of an event or cause

P1128.label: employees
P1128.description: total number of employees of a company at a given "point in time" (P585). Most recent data would generally have preferred rank; data for previous years normal rank (not deprecated rank). Add data for recent years, don't overwrite

P1132.label: number of participants
P1132.description: number of participants of an event, e.g. people or groups of people that take part in the event (NO units)

P1191.label: date of first performance
P1191.description: date a work was first debuted, performed or live-broadcasted (do not use for TV series episodes)

P1269.label: facet of
P1269.description: topic of which this item is an aspect; item that offers a broader perspective on the same topic

P1303.label: instrument
P1303.description: musical instrument that a person plays or teaches or used in a music occupation

P1308.label: position holder
P1308.description: persons who hold and/or held the position

P1346.label: winner
P1346.description: winner of a competition or similar event, not to be used from the awardees record (instead use "award received" (P166), possibly qualified with "for work" (P1686)) nor for wars or battles

P1365.label: replaces
P1365.description: person, state or item replaced. Use "structure replaces" (P1398) for structures. Use "follows" (P155) if the previous item was not replaced or predecessor and successor are identical

P1366.label: replaced by
P1366.description: other person or item which continues the item by replacing it in its role. Use P156 ("followed by") if the item is not replaced nor identical, but adds to the series (e.g. books in a series)

P1376.label: capital of
P1376.description: country, state, department, canton or other administrative division of which the municipality is the governmental seat

P1431.label: executive producer
P1431.description: executive producer of a movie, TV show, or other piece of media or entertainment

P1433.label: published in
P1433.description: larger work that a given work was published in, like a journal, a website, a collection, a book or a music album

P1441.label: present in work
P1441.description: this (fictional or fictionalized) entity, place, or person appears in that work as part of the narration (use P2860 for works citing other works, P361/P1433 for works being part of other works, P1343 for entities described in non-fictional accounts)

P1449.label: nickname
P1449.description: informal name (for a pseudonym use P742)

P1476.label: title
P1476.description: published name of a work, such as a newspaper article, a literary work, piece of music, a website, or a performance work

P1477.label: birth name
P1477.description: full name of a person at birth, if different from their current, generally used name

P1478.label: has immediate cause
P1478.description: nearest, proximate thing that directly resulted in the subject as outcome or effect. Used in conjunction with 'has cause' (i.e. underlying cause) and 'has contributing factor'. See 'Help:Modeling causes'.

P1479.label: has contributing factor
P1479.description: thing that significantly influenced, but did not directly cause, this outcome or effect. Used in conjunction with 'has cause' and 'has immediate cause'. See '[[Help:Modeling causes]]'.

P1535.label: used by
P1535.description: item or concept that makes use of the subject (use sub-properties when appropriate)

P1537.label: contributing factor of
P1537.description: thing that is significantly influenced by this cause, but does not directly result from it. See 'Help:Modeling causes' for examples and discussion.

P1545.label: series ordinal
P1545.description: position of an item in its parent series (most frequently a 1-based index), generally to be used as a qualifier (different from "rank" defined as a class, and from "ranking" defined as a property for evaluating a quality)

P1552.label: has characteristic
P1552.description: inherent or distinguishing quality or feature of the entity. Use a more specific property when possible

P1557.label: manifestation of
P1557.description: inherent and characteristic embodiment of a given concept

P1582.label: natural product of taxon
P1582.description: links a natural product with its source (animal, plant, fungal, algal, etc.)

P1589.label: lowest point
P1589.description: point with lowest elevation in a region or path

P1619.label: date of official opening
P1619.description: date or point in time a place, organization, or event officially opened

P1672.label: this taxon is source of
aliases: this taxon is the source of
this taxon is a source of
P1672.description: links a taxon to natural products it produces. Note that it does not say "this taxon is the source of" or "this taxon is a source of" as this may vary. Some products may be yielded by more than one taxon.

P1686.label: for work
P1686.description: qualifier of award received (P166) to specify the work that an award was given to the creator for

P1813.label: short name
P1813.description: short name of a place, organisation, person, journal, Wikidata property, etc. Used by some Wikipedia templates

P1923.label: participating team
P1923.description: like 'Participant' (P710) but for teams. For an event like a cycle race or a football match you can use this property to list the teams and P710 to list the individuals (with 'member of sports team' (P54) as a qualifier for the individuals)

P1995.label: health specialty
P1995.description: main specialty relevant to this medical condition or treatment

P2012.label: cuisine
P2012.description: type of food served by a restaurant or restaurant chain or national food culture

P2044.label: elevation above sea level
P2044.description: height of the item (geographical object) as measured relative to sea level

P2047.label: duration
P2047.description: length of time of an event or process

P2079.label: fabrication method
P2079.description: method, process or technique used to grow, cook, weave, build, assemble, manufacture the item

P2130.label: capital cost
P2130.description: amount of money spent on building or producing an object

P2142.label: box office
P2142.description: box office takings accumulated by a film

P2175.label: medical condition treated
aliases: capable of inhibiting or preventing pathological process
P2175.description: disease that this pharmaceutical drug, procedure, or therapy is used to treat

P2176.label: drug or therapy used for treatment
P2176.description: drug, procedure, or therapy that can be used to treat a medical condition

P2283.label: uses
P2283.description: item or concept used by the subject or in the operation (see also instrument [P1303] and armament [P520])

P2437.label: number of seasons
P2437.description: number of seasons a television or radio series has had

P2578.label: is the study of
P2578.description: the object that an academic field studies; distinct from field of work (P101), which is used for human, organization, etc.

P2579.label: studied by
P2579.description: subject is studied by this science or domain

P2670.label: has part(s) of the class
P2670.description: the subject has one or more parts of the object class

P2868.label: subject has role
aliases: subject of qualified statement has role
P2868.description: role held by the item the statement appears on ("subject") in the context of that statement. For the role of the statement object/value, use P3831 ("object has role"). For acting roles, use P453 ("character role"). For persons, use P39.

P2974.label: habitat
P2974.description: the natural environment in which an organism lives, or the physical environment that surrounds a species population

P2975.label: has host
P2975.description: an organism harboring another organism or organisms on or in itself

P3094.label: develops from
P3094.description: this class of items develops from another class of items (biology)

P3095.label: practiced by
P3095.description: type of agents that study this subject or work in this field

P3373.label: sibling
P3373.description: the subject and the object have at least one common parent (brother, sister, etc. including half-siblings); use "relative" (P1038) for siblings-in-law (brother-in-law, sister-in-law, etc.) and step-siblings (step-brothers, step-sisters, etc.)

P3450.label: sports season of league or competition
aliases: is an edition of athletics meeting
athletics meeting item belonging to this instance
P3450.description: property that shows the competition of which the item is a season. Use P5138 for "season of club or team".

P3831.label: object of statement has role
aliases: object of qualified statement has role
P3831.description: (qualifier) role held by the predicate value (object) of a statement in the context of that statement; for the role of the item the statement appears on (subject), use P2868

P4330.label: contains
P4330.description: contents, item or substance located within this wrapping item, but not part of this receptacle or container; does not describe the ingredients or components of this container

P4552.label: mountain range
P4552.description: range or subrange to which the geographical item belongs

P4584.label: first appearance
P4584.description: work in which a fictional/mythical character or entity first appeared

P4633.label: name of the character role
P4633.description: name by which a character role is recorded in a database or mentioned in the context of a work, use as qualifier for cast; notably a specific performance of a theatrical production of a play

P4908.label: season
P4908.description: season of a series (television, web, podcast)

P5642.label: risk factor
P5642.description: factor associated with a high prevalence of a particular gene, disease or characteristic. These factors can be country of origin, country of citizenship, race, gender, occupation, anamnesis, etc.

P9714.label: taxon range
P9714.description: geographic area(s) where a taxon is found
